title: Sales agent: recommended lead and opportunity actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing options and Dynamics 365 automation are supported. It correctly distinguishes the planned Microsoft 365 experience from the documented Dynamics 365 capability and leaves feature-specific billing and controls unconfirmed. The tenant access path could identify the application toggle more precisely.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a single prioritised list of lead and opportunity recommendations in Sales agent.
